pages.title: Introduction
pages.description: numera brings NumPy's n-dimensional arrays, linear algebra, FFT and random numbers to Node.js, backed by a native C++ core.

pages.title: Installation
pages.description: Install numera from npm. Prebuilt binaries for macOS and Linux, no compiler needed.

pages.title: Quickstart
pages.description: A short tour of numera 1.0.1: create arrays, do math, reduce, index and solve.

pages.title: Coming from NumPy
pages.description: How NumPy code translates to numera: naming, keyword arguments, indexing and return values.

pages.title: Array basics
pages.description: Shape, dtype, strides, views and copies, and converting to and from JavaScript values.

pages.title: Data types
pages.description: The 14 numeric dtypes, NumPy type promotion, weak JS scalars and 64-bit integers.

pages.title: Broadcasting
pages.description: How arrays of different shapes combine in element-wise operations.

pages.title: Indexing and slicing
pages.description: get, slice and set: integer, slice, ellipsis, newaxis, integer-array and boolean-mask indexing.

pages.title: Reductions
pages.description: sum, mean, std and friends with axis and keepdims.

pages.title: Random numbers
pages.description: Generator and the legacy API, with the same streams as NumPy for the same seed.

pages.title: Errors
pages.description: Typed error classes and floating-point behaviour.
